items.title: Fourth-grade reading scores fell two points between 2022 and 2024
items.description: The national average declined on the Nation’s Report Card. The results also show why an average alone cannot describe every student’s experience.

items.title: 22.9% of workers are in jobs requiring a license or certification
items.description: A national estimate shows how job requirements vary across occupations. It also leaves a key question open: which requirements come from government licensing rules?
